purpose: Append-only record of verified engineering milestones, discovery runs, build/test outcomes, releases, and operational incidents.

events.summary: Production crawler completed a measured crawl.
Supabase control plane showed healthy while PostgreSQL connections returned SQLSTATE 57P03 during WAL recovery. Destructive recovery actions were intentionally withheld.
Raised publisher staging page ceiling to 125,000 and added a regression test for catalogs above 100,000 pages.
Completed the publisher page-cap regression coverage.
First catalog-first discovery pass completed against four public open-data catalogs.
Discovery generated the catalog manifest, but the workflow git diff check did not detect an untracked file; persistence fix required staging before diff comparison.
Live production API returned HTTP 200 with catalog-unavailable, indexedPages 0 and upstream_http_403; fallback web results still returned. Production crawler catalog not confirmed active.
Added dependency-free, privacy-minimized feedback learner with bounded lane-weight candidates; production changes require review.
Raised independent recovery search capacity to 125,000 pages and 256 MB decoded shards; aligned browser catalog regression tests to the same limits.
